Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: A support that restricts translation develops a reaction force in the restrained direction; a support that prevents rotation develops a couple moment. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown lines 421-458, 472-510, 887-889, 1034-1038, 1061-1065, 1097-1099, 14916-15076, 16424-16580, 17316-17379, 19081-19412, 19476-19484, 21023-21037, and 26721-26870

Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: For coplanar rigid-body equilibrium, the three scalar equations are sum of horizontal forces, sum of vertical forces, and sum of moments equal to zero. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown lines 421-458, 472-510, 887-889, 1034-1038, 1061-1065, 1097-1099, 14916-15076, 16424-16580, 17316-17379, 19081-19412, 19476-19484, 21023-21037, and 26721-26870

Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: A body with redundant supports is statically indeterminate because it has more unknown loadings than available equilibrium equations. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown lines 421-458, 472-510, 887-889, 1034-1038, 1061-1065, 1097-1099, 14916-15076, 16424-16580, 17316-17379, 19081-19412, 19476-19484, 21023-21037, and 26721-26870

Hibbeler Statics 13th Edition: A body can also be improperly constrained when support reactions are all parallel or concurrent, even if the unknown count matches the equations. Locator: Hibbeler Statics refined markdown lines 421-458, 472-510, 887-889, 1034-1038, 1061-1065, 1097-1099, 14916-15076, 16424-16580, 17316-17379, 19081-19412, 19476-19484, 21023-21037, and 26721-26870
